# The generated routes of the package that embeds a template record its
# static assets route, even when the template is in a subdirectory. The
# <link> in templates/page.gohtml resolves to assets/style.css, which
# makes .x preserve whitespace: the section is reindented and the .x
# interior is kept as written.

muxt generate --input-static-assets-directory=assets --output-static-assets-path=/static --use-receiver-type=Server
! muxt fmt -l templates/page.gohtml
cmp stdout want-list.txt
muxt fmt templates/page.gohtml
stdout '(?m)^\t<p>a</p>$'
stdout '\n  keep   me\n</div>\n'

-- go.mod --
module example.com

go 1.24
-- templates.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed templates/*.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "templates/*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Index() string { return "" }
-- assets/style.css --
.x{white-space:pre}
-- templates/layout.gohtml --
{{define "GET / Index()"}}{{template "page.gohtml"}}{{end}}
-- templates/page.gohtml --
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/static/style.css">
<section>
<div class="x">
  keep   me
</div>
<p>a</p>
</section>
-- want-list.txt --
templates/page.gohtml
